# Jérôme Schaeffer — Personal Portfolio

> Frontend engineer based in Seoul, South Korea. Portfolio and resume site.

## About

Jérôme Schaeffer is a frontend engineer based in Seoul, South Korea with 11+ years of experience across startups, international companies, and consulting. He specializes in React, Next.js, TypeScript, Vue.js, product-focused UI, AI tools, MCP servers, and internal Claude workflows. This site serves as his personal portfolio and online resume.
